anatomy.body_build: adult human male, compact cuboid limbs and torso, clean joint separations; use the supplied base body guide for shoulder and limb proportions
anatomy.head_shape: rectangular voxel head with stepped chin and short round-profile ears
anatomy.ears: small bilateral voxel ears; preserve index-0 landmarks
anatomy.skin: light warm default from Face 01; Face generation uses the chosen Face record for its actual tones

proportions.source: Alpha catalog; occupied part sizes, not assembled rig or world-height dimensions

head_socket.status: PROPOSAL; coordinate basis measured on Alpha Face 01
head_socket.units: one source voxel edge; points are in voxel-boundary coordinates
head_socket.ear_landmark: bbox centres of measured ear-colour regions
head_socket.eye_landmark: centres of measured iris voxels in Face 01
head_socket.scale: keep reference grid and units constant across views; output px per voxel supplied by reference framing

body_socket.origin: midpoint between soles at ground plane
body_socket.neck_anchor: midpoint of neckline on body guide; align to head socket neck centre
body_socket.scale: fixed orthographic units per pixel across the four full-body plates
